observation: Concept staleness on upstream primitive change: AO2's initial re-lock claimed 'consumes existing Session/Sandbox primitive, concept not required' — yet AQ1 (#371) had just reshaped that primitive from isolated-boundary to host-directory. The concept gate did not re-check dependent WPs when a consumed primitive changed. Signal: downstream WPs whose concept gates reference 'existing primitive X' need re-evaluation if X's concept re-locks.

Concept altitude: initial re-lock was git-centric (mount = git checkout). Founder push (2026-06-28) surfaced the requirement to generalize to ALL filesystems (Obsidian folders, GDrive, S3). Phase 5 then architected the per-source adapter model. Evidence: Phase 5 adds 3 discriminant tables (local/remote/cloud per kind) not in Phase 2. Observation: the OPEN-kind probing (what are ALL the sources?) was under-explored in the first re-lock; concept phase should probe the open vocab harder before settling on examples.

AM4 redetect rate-limiter integration test flake is a standing CI liability (load-sensitive: 'expected 200 to be 429' intermittent failure; combined with attestation merge-ref drift, doc-only PRs took multiple verify/push cycles). Repro conditions: AM4's adapter-pool refreshDiscoveries() timing + full verify suite. Candidate mitigation flagged in architecture §14: make refreshDiscoveries() test-injectable (a test seam, not behavior change). Blocks ship if it reds during AO2 verify; only then unblock it.

Architecture critique 2 rounds caught 2 real pre-build defects: C1 = capture-teardown anchor was wrong (endSession not workspace.destroy has the rm -rf); C2 = SANDBOX_SCAFFOLDING_PATHS constant didn't exist + was under-inclusive (missing codex/opencode roots). Both caught by verifying claims against real code + line references rather than trusting the plan text. Reflects 'review-not-summary' discipline: the reviewer actually traced the teardown sequence + enumerated all harness provisioners.

Code review sanity-breaks caught 2 dishonest greens: (1) capture-ordering had no test (tests passed but the property was unproven); (2) drift-guard was decoupled (constant defined, test asserted the constant independently, never exercised real writer paths). Both stayed green when the underlying logic was broken because the test mocked/stubbed the real surface. Reflects CC-004 (mock-validation-trap): integration tests must exercise shipped code paths, never fabricated mocks. Reviewer forced real-roundtrip proofs.

Builder self-checked fix commits: reorder-tests showed red when capture-ordering test was added; add-writer-path to drift-guard turned the constant-test green. Builder did not ship hollow fixes; each fix verified its own red-then-green cycle before reporting. Signals good test-discipline and honest failure detection.

Scope vs effort: AO2 concept re-lock + generalization + 2 architecture critique rounds + build + 2 code-review NOT-DONE rounds = ~10d effort (concept ~2d, architecture ~2d, critique ~1d, build ~3d, review NOT-NOT-DONE ~2d). Concept re-lock was forced by AQ1; generalization was founder-driven; both added non-trivial scope. Live-proof added realness (real git worktree on THIS repo, real edit + commit + capture) without heavy infra (no npm check, no build inside integration test). Cost was front-loaded to concept + plan; build + review were 'right-sized' once plan stabilized.

PR consolidation (closed stale #370 pre-AQ1) + fresh branch off origin/main meant no merge-conflict rework and clean baseline for CI. Stale salvage (clone/bundle fragments from #370) was explicitly named in architecture (§8 salvage note) so builder knew WHAT to keep + WHY, not memorized guesses. Reflects 'search before building' ethos.
